thread:
maria: Hey team — quick release coordination for v1.12.0. Plan: tag, attach artifacts, publish a draft release, cut branch if necessary. Cutoff is EOD Friday PST. Who's taking the tag and draft?

alex: I can create the annotated tag and push. Quick check: do we want signed tags?

maria: Yes, please use annotated signed tag. Format: v{semver} and include changelog highlights in the message. Example: 
```
git tag -a v1.12.0 -m "v1.12.0 — release notes: batcher performance, fix CSV upload" -s
git push origin v1.12.0
```

jon: CI is ~green but there's one flaky test in runtime that I want to watch. If it flakes again, prefer we still cut but mark the release as "contains flaky test" in the notes. :warning:

release-bot: Build artifacts: succeeded (linux-x86_64, linux-aarch64). Checks: unit+integration passed. Coverage drop: 0.2%.

sam: For the draft release, I'll upload the two artifact tarballs and include SHA256 sums. Also add the generated changelog link and the migration note.

rachael: Heads up — any public-facing docs changes? We should coordinate with docs to avoid mismatch. I'll ping docs channel once draft is up. :memo:

maria: Good. Two process checks: 
1) Do not create the GitHub release from tag automatically — keep it as a draft until release lead verifies artifacts.
2) Annotated tag message should include "changelog: <link-to-pr>" and "release artifacts: <paths>".

alex: Got it. I'll create and sign the tag after sam attaches artifacts. Timeline: I can push the tag at 16:30 PST.

sam: I'll have artifacts uploaded by 16:15 PST.

jon: I will re-run the flaky test once more at 16:00 and report back. If green, ship as planned. If flaky, marking in notes and tagging still ok.

maria: Thanks — ping @here when draft is ready. I'll perform the final verification and publish the release. :rocket:

sam: Quick reminder for branch coordination: do we need a release branch? For a patch we can tag main; for more than doc/migration changes, let's create release/v1.12.0. I propose release branch — easier to cherry-pick if we must patch post-cutoff.

maria: Agreed. Create release/v1.12.0 if any late fixes are merged post-cutoff. For now tag main.

rachael: I'll block any docs merges to main after 17:00 PST unless explicitly approved.

alex: Tag ready to go, will push at 16:30 after sam's confirm.

release-bot: Noted. Reminder scheduled for 16:10 PST for artifact upload.

maria: Perfect — thanks everyone. Short checklist before publish: 
- annotated signed tag pushed (alex)
- artifacts uploaded to draft (sam)
- changelog link + migration note included (sam/rachael)
- CI green or note about flaky test (jon)
- docs synced (rachael)
- release lead publish (maria)

maria: If anything blocks, call it out here and we can delay the publish window by up to 2 hours. :eyes:
